Notebook Decorating

Ignite imagination as every child designs a unique journal they can use for recording secret memories, daily notes, or fun sketches.

With diverse stickers and bold hues, children breathe life into their journals. We provide pencil sets for customized taping to mark their own gear. A lively musical backdrop, set to their favorite hits, fuels the energetic atmosphere as every creative detail comes together perfectly.

2.5–3H TOTAL TIME, FOR PRICING CONTACT US
